headline: Treasury yields rise again
detail: Rising Treasury yields typically put pressure on growth and tech stocks, especially leveraged ones like your semiconductor ETFs. This trend can make holding these positions more volatile.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL given the negative PnL and the rising yield environment which can exacerbate losses.

headline: Morgan Stanley changed its tune on the U.S. dollar
detail: A shift in outlook on the U.S. dollar can signal broader economic sentiment changes. While not directly tech-specific, it can influence overall market risk appetite.
